verdict.rationale: Ultrametric documents an official hosted remote MCP server at https://api.ultrametric.ai/mcp, with connection steps, OAuth scopes, and a tools reference including a `status` tool. Live probes confirm the endpoint exists and returns a standards-compliant RFC 9728 OAuth wall (401 plus a live protected-resource metadata document), which is the expected sign-in behavior and does not contradict the docs. Missing for 10: no authenticated initialize/tools/list session observed hands-on, and the full MCP tool catalog is only thinly evidenced beyond `status`.
